name: Candied Sweet Potatoes
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 4 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced
4 Granny Smith apples, peeled, cored, and sliced

steps: Arrange sliced sweet potatoes, apples, and raisins in a greased 2-quart baking dish.
Mix the liquids and butter together. Pour over the dish's contents.
Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 30 to 45 minutes, until sweet potatoes are tender and glazed.

culture.text: The potato is a starchy tuberous vegetable native to the Americas that is consumed as a staple food in many parts of the world. Potatoes are underground stem tubers of the plant Solanum tuberosum, a perennial in the nightshade family Solanaceae.
